steps.en: Start the Grist server with a persist directory
steps.zh: 带 persist 目录启动 Grist 服务器

steps.en: Prints an admin boot key and serves the Quick setup page
steps.zh: 打印管理员 boot key，起 Quick setup 页

steps.en: Paste the boot key, pick the admin email and sign-in method
steps.zh: 粘贴 boot key，选管理员邮箱与登录方式

steps.en: Build sheets whose columns are typed fields with Python formulas
steps.zh: 建表：列即类型化字段，公式用 Python 写

steps.en: Recomputes references and choices table-wide as data changes
steps.zh: 数据一变，引用与选项整表联动重算

steps.en: Serves row-level access rules, live presence, webhooks and the REST API
steps.zh: 行级权限、在线状态、webhook 与 REST API 一并供出

value.en: The team's spreadsheet now behaves like a small database-backed app — permissions, forms, dashboards and APIs included — in one container you own
value.zh: 团队的表格从此表现得像一个有数据库撑腰的小应用——权限、表单、看板、API 全配齐——跑在你自己的一个容器里

sources: https://github.com/gristlabs/grist-core/blob/main/README.md — 'Using Grist' section: docker run -p 8484:8484 -v $PWD/persist:/persist -it gristlabs/grist; Quick setup + boot key; Python formulas; row/column/table access control; webhooks; REST API (fetched 2026-09-27)
